parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of combining orthogonal units by checking for non-integer powers in the conversion matrix. It seems to be a minimal and targeted fix.

issues.description: The patch does not handle cases where the units are not directly compatible but can be converted through intermediate steps. This may lead to incomplete resolution of the issue.
The patch introduces a new condition and changes the existing logic slightly, which may not fully align with the project's coding style or conventions.
